author: hdprajwal
abstract: An AI agent skill that makes any writing sound plain, human, and simple. Merges three earlier skills: a plain-voice writing target (plain spoken English, no clever phrasing, no swagger, no inflated claims), a 38-pattern de-AI detection catalog (based on Wikipedia's 'Signs of AI writing'), and a one-pass quality-gate process (intake, single scan, clean-exit decision, prioritized rewrite, anti-AI audit). The plain voice is the north star; the catalog and process serve it.
